size.value: Dominica's official visitor's-visa page requires "2 passport sized (recent) photographs" — i.e. the same 45mm(H) × 38mm(W) standard published on the same government portal's passport page. Matches DB's 3.8 × 4.5cm.

background.value: Acceptable background colours (per the cross-referenced passport-photo standard on the same government portal): white, light grey, light blue, light brown, or beige; must contrast with clothing, no shadows

clothing_restriction.value: No bold prints; no military or camouflage-pattern clothing; no sleeveless or tank tops — chest area must be covered

expression_restriction.value: Facial expression must be neutral; applicant may smile but the mouth must not be open

headwear_policy.value: No head coverings permitted, except in the case of Muslims

clothing.en: No bold prints, no military or camouflage-pattern clothing, no sleeveless or tank tops — the chest area must be covered.
clothing.ko: 화려한 프린트 무늬, 군복·카모플라주 패턴 착용 금지. 민소매·탱크톱 금지 — 가슴 부위가 가려져야 함.
clothing.ja: 派手な柄物や迷彩・軍服調の服は不可。ノースリーブ・タンクトップも不可 — 胸元が隠れている必要あり。

expression.en: Neutral facial expression required; a smile is allowed but the mouth must remain closed.
expression.ko: 무표정(중립적 표정) 필수. 미소는 허용되나 입은 다물어야 함(치아 노출 금지).
expression.ja: 無表情(自然な表情)が必須。微笑みは可だが口は閉じること(歯が見えるのは不可)。

glasses.en: Shaded or dark sunglasses are not allowed.
glasses.ko: 색이 들어간 선글라스나 짙은 색 안경 착용 불가.
glasses.ja: 色付きサングラスや濃い色のメガネの着用は不可。

headwear.en: No head coverings are permitted, except for Muslim applicants.
headwear.ko: 머리 가리개(모자 등) 착용 불가. 단, 무슬림의 경우 예외 인정.
headwear.ja: 帽子などの被り物は不可。ただしムスリムの場合は例外として認められる。

db_conflicts.research_value: dominica.gov.dm lists FIVE acceptable background colours — white, light grey, light blue, light brown, beige — not white exclusively.

methodology_note.note: The Dominica non-national visitor's-visa page (official) states only '2 passport sized (recent) photographs' and does not re-itemize detailed specs. Detailed values (background colour list, clothing, expression, glasses, headwear) were cross-referenced from the SAME government domain's (dominica.gov.dm) passport-photo requirements page, on the basis that the visa page explicitly ties its photo standard to the passport-size standard. This is a same-domain cross-reference, not a third-party source.

validity.note: The visa page itself does not restate a photo-age limit (only 'recent'). The passport page states 'not more than six months old' — left in unverified rather than asserted for the visa slug specifically, since the visa page does not repeat this figure verbatim.
